first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The dark gray-black handgun in the lower-right portion of the first-person view; after it rotates, its elongated slide, side, and trigger guard are visible, while the grip end is partially occluded.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: An elderly male-presenting character with gray-white hair puffed out to both sides and a white mustache on the upper lip, wearing a long white coat, blue shirt, red-and-blue tie, khaki trousers, and dark-colored shoes.

entities.name: riveted metal wall panel
entities.identification: Large light gray to blue-gray rectangular wall panels enclosing the small room, with dark-colored seams and rows of rivets along the panel edges.

entities.name: metal floor
entities.identification: A gray-brown to gray-green floor made of metal panels, with straight seams and dense, repeating embossed patterns.

entities.name: dark-colored metal ceiling
entities.identification: The dark green to nearly black ceiling above the small room, with a layered gray border around it and parallel dark-colored groove lines.

entities.name: indoor light fixture
entities.identification: A single rectangular light fixture on the ceiling, with a blue-white luminous surface embedded in the underside of a blocky gray-blue housing.
